independentReview.scope: schema/counter interpretation and consistency; no image review attributed

limits: This is an instrumented diagnostic run. Clock reads, trace objects, counters, safe-flush bookkeeping and output add overhead that is not independently quantified.
Durations are inclusive, rounded milliseconds. Do not add nested buckets or add the cumulative checkpoints together, subtract child times to claim exclusive cost, or treat them as CPU time.
The started record declares a 60,000 ms window scoped before human.admit. Checkpoints are emitted at safe flushes and contain settled-within-window totals, not a completed-request profile.
Five periodic snapshots stop at 50,000 ms. There is no final record or preview response; the unobserved tail and later server outcome remain unknown.
The last pending count of 1 is the tracked comparison.scenario-fences span with 52 entries and 51 settlements. It is not a count of all work in the application.

Canonical unit/expansion fields are conservative estimates and maxima, not measured output bytes. Prefix and maximum fields can come from different calls and must not be combined into a single complete graph.
The 25 comparison.proof / batch.hit events count proof-branch selections that still require the final fence; they do not establish 25 successful authorized egresses.
Absent bucket rows are reported as not emitted in these snapshots, not as a measured whole-request zero.
History response events preserve status ok and array shape, not array cardinality. The static History panel is a separate visual observation.
The final Running/skeleton capture does not establish later completion, unwind, cancellation or persistence outcome.
No visual qualification, acceptance-count change or causal performance gain is established. The artifact ZIP is metadata-only; no raw log or Omni control value is archived.
